        categorical_cols.append(col)
    else:
        numeric_cols.append(col)

# Handle high cardinality categorical column by dropping

    col for col in categorical_cols if len(train_df[col].unique()) < 5000
]

# Encode categorical features

    for col in categorical_cols:
        le = LabelEncoder()
        train_df[col] = train_df[col].apply(lambda x: le.fit_transform(x))
        test_df[col] = test_df[col].apply(lambda x: le.transform(x))

# Create feature matrix

# Combine scaled and encoded categorical for final feature matrix

)

)

# Validate on held-out set
val_pred_prob = gb.predict_proba(X_test_val)[:, 1]
auc_valid = roc_auc_score(y_test_val, val_pred_prob)
print(f"Validation ROC AUC Score: {auc_valid:.4f}")

# Generate predictions on test set
test_pred_prob = gb.predict_proba(X_final_test)[:, 1]
